correctness.rationale: M(K7) has exactly 21 zero-,105 one-,105 two-simplices, checked from disjoint graph-edge matchings. C7 moves each nonempty face freely since an orbit of any single graph edge has length 7>3 (maximum matching size). Quotient face counts are (3,15,15). Reconstructed quotient cell boundary and 15 cyclic attaching relators from canonical oriented face orbits independently of certificate text; contracting spanning one-cell orbits A1,A2 and 12 actual single-occurrence Tietze eliminations (indices 4,0,8,9,3,13,10,6,12,7,5,14) leave one generator A11 with relators u^-21, 1, u^-42. Thus the entire nonabelian π1 is Z/21, not merely its abelianization. Cellular χ=3; H1=Z/21, H2 is free of rank 2 because kernel of boundary between integral free chains, higher zero by dimension. Complete finite enumeration and reversible word moves verify the one fixed complex.
